text:
Assistant A gives the correct category for each of the four questions (Literature, History, Science, Art) in the requested line-by-line format, with no extra words. Its only flaw is that it doesn't number the lines, which the prompt doesn't require.

Assistant B adds long, irrelevant, repetitive and partly inaccurate text. It also never answers question 4, and it breaks the instruction to avoid extraneous words.

[[A]]
